symptoms: Minute dark brown necrotic spots on leaves and stems; plants turn blackish and shrivel
management: Foliar spray of Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L immediately after rain/dew in flowering stage

healthy_signs: Crisp, aromatic foliage free from leaf spot lesions or marginal blight
Vigorous rhizome/vine growth with vibrant green shoots
Clean floral spikes/umbels with high fruit set
Basal root collar completely firm without water-soaked decay
management: Prune and remove infected runners or lateral branches early in the day
Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture on foliar canopy and drench root basin with bio-fungicide
Regulate canopy shade to reduce damp microclimate
prevention: Use shade regulation (50-60% filtered sunlight) during monsoon to prevent high humidity buildup
Drench plant basins with Copper Oxychloride or Trichoderma-enriched compost
Ensure zero waterlogging in hill slopes through contour trench drainage
Collect and destroy fallen infected leaves, spikes, and diseased capsules
